purpose: Document current public topic signals and primary-source facts for two English/Simplified Chinese AI browser and browser tooling articles. Public search result counts are evidence of visible discussion only, not BrowserHub traffic or market demand estimates.

executor.modelEffectiveNote: The runtime did not report the actual model identifier.

humanizerPass.actions: Reviewed English and Simplified Chinese prose for staged openers, repeated section patterns, redundant closers, forced parallel phrasing, and unsupported first-person experience. Rechecked the affected paragraphs after the factual revision. Product names, command text, links, versions, and source-backed uncertainty were preserved.

correctionAttempts.trigger: Independent review identified an inaccurate description of Playwright MCP isolated-session storage.
correctionAttempts.issue: The first draft implied that providing --storage-state makes changes in the new isolated session persist. The option initializes a context from saved state; it does not save changes made afterward.
correctionAttempts.reasoning: Separate initial state from session persistence: isolated changes are lost when the browser closes; --storage-state supplies starting data; persistent profiles retain state across restarts, while updated storage must be exported separately if required.

method.searchMethod: Web search for current CSDN topic pages and official product documentation, followed by opening primary GitHub README/docs and current vendor help pages.
method.firecrawl: The Firecrawl CLI was not found on PATH in the zsh shell used for this task (command lookup returned 'command not found'). This observation is scoped to that shell environment and does not establish that the CLI is absent elsewhere on the machine. The available web search/open interface was used. No page interaction or product testing was performed.
limits: Search snippets and displayed article reads are snapshots; they can vary by account, region, crawl and time.
Displayed reads are cumulative page-level figures where explicitly present. They do not establish recent growth, search volume, demand size, or BrowserHub traffic.
Vendor documentation describes intended or supported product capabilities. It does not establish independent reliability, comparative performance, or availability for every account and region.
GitHub main-branch documentation is mutable. The user's installed package version may not match the documentation observed on this date.
No software was installed and no browser workflow, benchmark, or compatibility test was run.

topics.intent: Definition and task selection: distinguish browser-embedded AI assistance from systems that plan and execute browser actions, then choose a capability and permission boundary for a concrete task.
topics.distinctFrom: The MCP comparison article is a developer tool comparison for page automation and Chrome diagnostics. This topic does not compare MCP servers or installation commands.

primarySources.title: Google Chrome Help: Gemini in Chrome and Auto Browse
primarySources.claimScope: The help page distinguishes a contextual Gemini side panel from Auto Browse, which can navigate websites, click and fill forms. This supports a feature-based capability ladder, not a universal definition of AI browser.

primarySources.title: Google: Gemini Spark now integrates with Chrome
primarySources.claimScope: The July 30, 2026 announcement says Chrome-integrated Auto Browse can use logged-in accounts and saved passwords with permission, and hands sensitive actions such as payments back to the user. The source describes Google's announced experience and initial availability, not universal access.

primarySources.title: Perplexity: The New Comet Assistant
primarySources.claimScope: Perplexity describes multi-tab work, browser interaction and asking the user before tasks that call for browser interaction. These are vendor claims about Comet Assistant.

primarySources.title: Browser Use official repository and README
primarySources.claimScope: The current repository distinguishes hosted agent, CLI, and Python library paths; CLI/library can connect to local or cloud browsers. Used as an example that browser agents may be a separate library/runtime rather than a built-in browser feature. No pricing or benchmark claims used.

topics.editorialDecision: Publish as a practical classification and task-boundary guide. Describe AI browser and browser agent as working terms whose features overlap, then give a three-level capability check, task examples, approval points, and recovery checks. Avoid claiming one universal taxonomy or declaring named products equivalent.

primarySources.title: Microsoft Playwright MCP README and profile configuration
primarySources.claimScope: Documents persistent, isolated and extension-based existing-browser modes; persistent profile paths are workspace-derived and only one instance can use a profile at a time. Changes in an isolated session are lost when the browser closes. The --storage-state option initializes a session from a saved state file; it does not persist changes made during that session.

primarySources.title: Microsoft Playwright: Getting started with MCP
primarySources.claimScope: Documents headed mode, persistent versus isolated sessions, extension attachment, idle timeout behavior, and the loss of isolated in-memory state on close. It describes storage-state as an initial-state input, not a mechanism that writes changes from the new isolated session back to that file.

topics.editorialDecision: Publish a task-selection comparison focused on context isolation, existing-browser connection, and DevTools-only diagnostic tools. Include version-specific remote-debugging requirements, profile contention, read-only connection checks, and source-backed security limits. Do not assert speed, accuracy, universal browser support, or a product winner.
